notes.heading: Comparing
notes.text: Toggle the reference against either render. The previous render is the dist-gated 90T recreation, and the revised one is the 108T pulley of DC-12, as external_pulley.scad's header explains: it keeps the hub, the spokes and the inner 1.4 mm of the rim and adds the 108T rim. No fit is added, because S1 stands at least 0.25 a side off the C-503 strakes and B1's Ø9.0 stands 0.5 a side off the Ø8 stainless tube. The dimensions are in 430-002_ExternalInnerPulley.scad's header. Run render.rs --verify before building this page, because the renders are its output.
